summary: Iteration 2: validated master-zone-card refactor + fault codes feature. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass, added coverage for fault_codes in /api/system, /api/system/master-power (off/on cascades to zones), /api/system/diagnostic (0-2 faults), zone rename via PUT /api/zones/{id}, and unique is_master zone (Salon). Frontend: Playwright end-to-end verified master card rendering with GAINABLE badge, master rename flow, mode chaud/froid toggle, all fan speeds (auto/bas/moyen/haut), master setpoint +/-, diagnostic button updates fault-codes section, master-shutdown-btn toggles system + label text, non-master zones support rename/setpoint/toggle, Appareils and Planning tabs load. All flows integrated with backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend startup/shutdown decorators still deprecated; migrate to FastAPI lifespan (non-blocking).
PUT /api/zones accepts is_master toggle but does not enforce single-master invariant — could result in 0 or multiple masters if abused (currently no UI path exercises this, so low risk).
master-power endpoint uses query param (?on=true) instead of JSON body; functional but inconsistent with other PUT/POST endpoints.
System seed inserts one initial fault_code (EE) which persists until diagnostic replaces it — acceptable for mock demo.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 system doc (with EE fault), 6 zones (Salon is_master=true), 7 devices. One non-master zone was renamed to 'TEST Zone Renamed' during test and not reverted (mock data, non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite covers all new endpoints (master-power, diagnostic, is_master invariant, zone rename). Frontend polls /api/simulate/tick every 4s — do not assert exact temp values. One zone was renamed 'TEST Zone Renamed' by playwright and not reverted; main agent may want to reset seed if needed.
